summary: Support agent principals and mission and step lane capacity in the TypeScript declarations SDK

rules.detail: The declarations SDK emits optional agent principal, mission capacity and step capacity children using the existing KDL grammar. Mission capacity defaults omitted lane properties; step capacity names at least one lane property and only raises the selected seat lane. Canonical principals and lane bounds remain validated by the declaration parser.

compatibility.detail: All new authoring fields are optional; existing output is unchanged.
